page_title: LEC 2-2 PAR | Lecce v Parma 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Anas Haj Mohamed sends a long raking pass onto the head of Antoine Hainaut (Parma), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
90+5' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Parma will take a corner kick.
90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Pontus Almqvist (Parma) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
90+2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but fails to dummy him and his effort is thwarted.
90+1' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Parma.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Parma take a short corner kick.
86' Antonino Gallo goes off the pitch and Andy Pelmard (Lecce) comes on.
84' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
84' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

83' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner on the edge of the box and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
83' The ball is out of play. Parma win a corner kick.
82' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though.
77' The referee points to the corner flag and Parma will take a corner.
77' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
75' Here is a change. Tete Morente is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
75' Substitution. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) has come on for Ylber Ramadani.
71' Parma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
71' Dennis Man (Parma) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hernani will be replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
65' Fabio Pecchia decides to make a substitution. Valentin Mihaila will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
65' It's time for a substitution. Antoine Hainaut (Parma) comes on in place of Yordan Osorio.
65' A substitution has been made. Ante Rebic is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
64' Luca Gotti has decided to substitute Lassana Coulibaly and he is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).

64' Dennis Man sprays a wonderful pass out to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Wladimiro Falcone problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.

63' Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save! Dennis Man (Parma) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
59' 2 - 0 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Zion Suzuki stranded. 2:0.
58' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
57' Referee Marco Guida sees the trip by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
57' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. Parma earn a free kick.
55' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
55' Dennis Man (Parma) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
54' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
52' Parma earn a corner.
51' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
49' Dennis Man (Parma) takes the free kick from long range and unleashes a strong shot. Unfortunately for him the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
47' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) receives a red card for his foul. Looking at it again, it's a harsh red card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Wladimiro Falcone was forced into action to thwart Dennis Man (Parma). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
42' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
39' Hernani (Parma) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
37' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Simon Sohm leaves the pitch to be replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma).
35' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

32' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) latches on to a precise through ball from Ylber Ramadani before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
31' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
28' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
19' A quickly taken corner by Parma.

19' A sweet pass finds Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Wladimiro Falcone is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.

18' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wladimiro Falcone makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
15' Tete Morente (Lecce) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
14' Ante Rebic (Lecce) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
12' Good work from Parma as they win a corner.
12' Dennis Man (Parma) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
10' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Lecce will kick-off.
Marco Guida is the one to supervise the game today.
